structure_policy_rationale: Following the pattern of Alipay and Douyin, the core logo geometry must be strictly preserved to ensure instant recognition. The transformation is purely material (flat vector to 3D ice) and dimensional (adding thickness), without altering the silhouette or spatial relationship of the peaks.
preserve: The precise angle of the chevrons
The relative size and position of the two intersecting parts
Rounded corners of the stroke ends
must_preserve: The exact vector path of the double-peak 'M' logo
The overlapping intersection point between the left and right peaks
recompose_allowed: Convert flat white fill to translucent ice blue volume
Replace background gradient with pure white
Substitute internal details with frozen bubbles and snowflake textures
restyle: Add surface condensation droplets and embedded snowflakes
Round sharp edges to mimic melted/polished ice
Enhance center intersection with subsurface scattering/refraction effects
decorate: Micro-textures of condensation droplets on surface
Internal macro-textures of bubbles and ice fractures
Stylized snowflake patterns embedded within the volume
forbid: Changing the logo to a literal camera, microphone, or meeting table icon
Using the original dark blue brand color
Creating a flat 2D blue shape without 3D volume
generation_brief: 3D ice sculpture of Tencent Meeting's abstract 'M' logo (two interlocking peaks). Material: translucent pale cyan ice with internal bubbles, snowflakes, and condensation droplets. Style: glossy, rounded edges, strong refraction at center intersection. Background: clean white with subtle contact shadow and melting water puddle at base. No text, no original brand colors.
color_application: Discard original brand blue/white. Apply uniform 'frozen water' aesthetic: Pale Cyan/Ice Blue for the body, Translucent White for highlights, Cool Grey for shadows. Maintain high contrast against white background via lighting rather than color difference.
stroke_application: Eliminate all 2D strokes. Define shape through 3D volume, edge highlighting, and light refraction. Ensure contours are smooth, continuous, and rounded like worn ice.
composition_application: Center the 3D 'M' object occupying 70-80% of canvas. Anchor on a virtual ground plane with contact shadow. Integrate the two peaks into a single cohesive ice mass while preserving their distinct geometric intersection.
identity_application: Preserve the exact topology of the double-peak 'M' structure. Use the central overlapping area to showcase theme-specific refraction and subsurface scattering, turning the original 'connection' visual cue into a physical ice fusion effect.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified ice blue semi-transparent material, strictly no original brand colors.
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice crack textures.
Subject must exhibit clear 3D volume with thickness, not a flat cutout.
Background must be clean white/high-key grey.
negative_constraints: No flat vector styles or 2D appearances.
No warm colors, fire, wood, metal, or stone materials.
No complex scenes or dark backgrounds.
No distortion of the 'M' shape into waves or mountains.
No opaque plastic or glass look; must be specifically 'ice'.
